text:
Maya Patel: Quick sync requested by HW partners — they need our verified driver/CUDA/ROCm matrix for the marketplace listing and the joint announcement. We also need to agree pinning policy, canary window, and hotfix flow. Who can own the matrix and timeline?

Liam Chen: I can own NVIDIA matrix and pins. Suggest we publish a concise verified table for marketplace and keep detailed compatibility notes in docs.

Anika Rao: Ill own ROCm side. Note: we saw a perf regression in ROCm 5.7 with runtime v1.3 on the quantized path in last perf run.

Jules: Timeline: marketplace listing draft needs the verified matrix by Mon May 12 (2 weeks). Joint announcement target = end of May. Can we commit?

Tom H: SIs require a 2-week canary after any pin change and an early-access branch for validation. Also need a simple checklist for their infra teams.

Liam Chen: Proposed policy:
- GA matrix: keep minimal (2 driver/CUDA combos per vendor)
- Canary pool: add 2 more combos per vendor for a 2-week canary
- Hotfix: emergency rollback + vendor driver patch coordination

Anika Rao: For ROCm I recommend GA = 5.6.x (last known-good). Canary = 5.7 to catch regressions. Ill open a ticket with perf diffs.

Maya Patel: Please add perf numbers and a short reproduction snippet. Marketplace team wants a one-line verified blurb per vendor.

Anika Rao: Repro snippet Im attaching to the ticket:
```
./run_inference_bench --model redwood-7b --batch 8 --seq 2048 --iters 50
```
Bench result summary (will attach logs in ticket): 5.7 shows ~12% slower p95 on quantized path compared to 5.6.

Liam Chen: On NVIDIA we observed kernel path slowdown on driver 535.XX + CUDA 12.2 for our quantized kernels. Recommend GA pin: driver 535.54 + CUDA 12.1; canary: 535.86 + CUDA 12.2.

Jules: Marketplace copy needs a 1-line verification per vendor by EOD Fri. Can the blurbs be safe and non-technical?

Tom H: Example blurb that works for SIs: "Redwood Inference verified on NVIDIA driver 535.54 + CUDA 12.1 and AMD ROCm 5.6; canary coverage for newer driver builds."

Infra Bot: deploy-canary job started for nvidia-canary pool (job id: deploy-2026-05-04-09). Logs: http://ci.internal/deploy-2026-05-04-09

Liam Chen: Ill update the matrix doc with exact package pins and install commands, and tag @Tom H and @Jules when done. Plan includes SHA/apt/rpm pins where applicable.

Anika Rao: Ill file the ROCm regression ticket with bench artifacts and add a brief mitigation plan (workaround + vendor escalation). Tagging @Maya Patel.

Maya Patel: Action items:
- Liam: publish NVIDIA matrix + package pins (by Thu)
- Anika: open ROCm regression ticket + attach bench logs (by Wed)
- Tom: confirm SI canary window and validation checklist (by Fri)
- Jules: draft marketplace blurb once pins are available (EOD Fri)

Maya Patel: Keep the marketplace matrix lean; expand technical compat matrix in the public docs and internal compatibility playbook. Ping this thread with updates :thumbsup:
